profileDecisionJa: レビ人の系譜に現れる名です。6章の二つの名簿に記されますが、ほかの書の同名者とは結び付けません。

articlesRead.locator: Live section lines 173–177 says a Zerah is a Gershonite Levite and cites 1CH6:6, 6:26; the current profile records two Zerah-named points in different portions of the WEB genealogy (6:21 son of Iddo; 6:41 son of Adaiah). Article does not distinguish whether either or both rows are the same referent.
